questions.question: Which of the following is an important principle in performance testing?

choices.A: The tests should be easy to create and understand
choices.B: The test results must be reproducible when the system under test is unchanged
choices.C: The tests should be executed in the production environment to provide the most accurate results
choices.D: The test results should match the stakeholders' expectations for system performance

correctAnswerText: The test results must be reproducible when the system under test is unchanged
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. Because tests are sometimes quite complex to create

b) Is correct. Reproducible results are a key factor in performance test execution. The results should be statistically identical when run on the same unchanged system

c) Is not correct. Because tests generally should not be run in the actual production environment, but rather a representative equivalent

d) Is not correct. Because the test results may show that the system does not meet expectations.

questions.question: Which of the following is the best description of spike testing?

choices.A: It focuses on the ability of the system to handle loads that are gradually increased to reach the expected maximum
choices.B: It focuses on the ability of the system to handle loads that are at or beyond the expected peak load
choices.C: It focuses on the ability of the system to meet future efficiency requirements
choices.D: It focuses on the ability of the system to respond to quick and extreme changes in load

correctAnswerText: It focuses on the ability of the system to respond to quick and extreme changes in load
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. Is a description of load testing

b) Is not correct. Is a description of stress testing

c) Is not correct. Is a description of scalability testing

d) Is correct. This is a description of spike testing

questions.question: Which of the following is the best description of load testing?

choices.A: It focuses on the ability of the system to handle loads that are gradually increased to reach the expected maximum
choices.B: It focuses on the ability of the system to handle loads that are at or beyond the expected peak load
choices.C: It focuses on the ability of the system to meet future efficiency requirements
choices.D: It focuses on the ability of the system to respond to quick and extreme changes in load

correctAnswerText: It focuses on the ability of the system to handle loads that are gradually increased to reach the expected maximum
questions.explanation:
a) Is correct. This is a description of load testing

b) Is not correct. Is a description of stress testing

c) Is not correct. Is a description of scalability testing

d) Is not correct. Is a description of spike testing

questions.question: Which of the following performance testing activities should occur during unit testing?

choices.A: Testing end-to-end behavior under various load conditions
choices.B: Testing data flows and workflows across interfaces
choices.C: Testing key use cases and workflows using a top-down approach
choices.D: Testing to evaluate resource utilization and potential bottlenecks

correctAnswerText: Testing to evaluate resource utilization and potential bottlenecks
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. Because this occurs at system or SIT

b) Is not correct. Because this occurs during SIT

c) Is not correct. Because this is done during integration testing

d) Is correct. While this can occur at any time, it should start with unit testing

questions.question: When is it appropriate to generate load via the application's APIs?

choices.A: When a large number of testers are available who can represent the real users
choices.B: When testing must be conducted at the communications protocol level
choices.C: When the UI is likely to change but the transactions must be processed as if they were created through the UI
choices.D: When only small numbers of test instances are available

correctAnswerText: When the UI is likely to change but the transactions must be processed as if they were created through the UI
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. Because this is crowd testing, and these testers would be using the real UI

b) Is not correct. Because the communications protocol level is one level below the API level

c) Is correct. Testing through the API makes the most sense when the UI is likely to change, but the full communication to and from the UI must be tested

d) Is not correct. Because many test instances can be created with API testing

questions.question: If you have an application that has a memory leak, what is the likely result you will see during performance testing?

choices.A: Response time will be consistently slow
choices.B: Response time will remain acceptable, but the error handling will degrade
choices.C: Response time will be slow, but only under heavy loads
choices.D: Response time will degrade over time

correctAnswerText: Response time will degrade over time
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. Is an indication of underlying performance issues such as bad design, under-powered hardware, network latency, etc.

b) Is not correct. Is an indication of resource pool or queue or stack issues as well as invalid timeout settings

c) Is not correct. Is an indication that some of the resources may become saturated, but only at high loads

d) Is correct. With a memory leak, response time will degrade over time (the time length is unknown though until you test it)

questions.question: Which of the following is a true statement regarding tracking metrics for network latency during a performance test?

choices.A: High latency could indicate a network bandwidth problem that could negatively impact performance
choices.B: Low latency could indicate a network bandwidth problem that could negatively impact performance
choices.C: Network latency is difficult to track and should not be included in the performance metrics
choices.D: Network latency is too variable to be useful during performance tuning

correctAnswerText: High latency could indicate a network bandwidth problem that could negatively impact performance
questions.explanation:
a) Is correct. A high latency means that there are delays occurring in the network which may be due to inadequate bandwidth

b) Is not correct. Because low latency is a good thing

c) Is not correct. Because this is trackable with the right tools

d) Is not correct. Because if there is variability, that needs to be understood as part of the performance tests

questions.question: Should performance test results be aggregated?

choices.A: Yes, this gives a better overall picture of the performance of the system and helps to identify trends
choices.B: Yes, this is the best way to focus on the outliers in the performance metrics
choices.C: No, the results should be analyzed individually so that all variations are understood
choices.D: No, the results from each test should be reported and tracked separately

correctAnswerText: Yes, this gives a better overall picture of the performance of the system and helps to identify trends
questions.explanation:
a) Is correct. Aggregated results help to provide the big picture and to observe consistent trends. Aggregating the results helps to identify and understand the importance of outliers and to know which ones interesting vs are just test aberrations

b) Is not correct. Because aggregated results will eliminate the information on the outliers

c) Is not correct. Because aggregation allows you to see the big picture rather than focusing on the individual results which may be due to transient system noise. It is unlikely to ever reach the point where "all" variations are understood

d) Is not correct. Because this type of reporting will be too difficult for stakeholders to understand and may focus on the highly unlikely situations

questions.question: In what way are log analysis tools helpful for collecting metrics?

choices.A: They monitor the systems while the performance tests are conducted and report on the behavior during the tests
choices.B: They create the system load and monitor the system performance
choices.C: They scan the various server logs and compile metrics for occurrences that were recorded during the test execution
choices.D: They write the performance results to the server logs for later manual analysis

correctAnswerText: They scan the various server logs and compile metrics for occurrences that were recorded during the test execution
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. As these are general system monitoring tools

b) Is not correct. As these are performance testing tools

c) Is correct. The log analysis tools scan the server logs for particular error types (high usage, memory errors, etc.) and report on those

d) Is not correct. Because the performance test results are not written to the logs, rather the system activities during the performance tests are written to the logs

questions.question: Which of the following is a failure that would typically be found by conducting a spike test?

choices.A: The system performance gradually degrades
choices.B: The system provides inconsistent responses to errors
choices.C: The system handles a sudden burst of activity, but cannot resume a steady state
choices.D: The system performs well for the expected load, but cannot scale to a larger load

correctAnswerText: The system handles a sudden burst of activity, but cannot resume a steady state
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. As this is a result of an endurance test

b) Is not correct. Because this is an example of resource degradation over time

c) Is correct. This is a description of a failure that has resulted from a spike test.

d) Is not correct. Because this is the result of a scalability test

questions.question:
Consider the following technical environments:
1. Single computer
2. Multi-tier system
3. Distributed
4. Virtualized
5. Dynamic/Cloud-based
6. Client/Server and Browser-based
7. Mobile
8. Embedded
9. Mainframe
Which of these is most likely to have a performance risk due to connectivity issues?
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. Because these environments are not prone to connection dropping

b) B is correct according to the syllabus. Mobile and embedded environments are particularly prone to connectivity issues particularly when embedded software is used in the IoT devices

c) Is not correct. Because other than #7, the other environments are not prone to connection dropping

d) Is not correct. Because these environments are not prone to connection dropping

questions.question:
Consider the following technical environments:
1. Virtualized
2. Dynamic/Cloud-based
3. Client/Server and Browser-based
4. Mobile
5. Embedded
6. Mainframe
Which of these is most likely to have a performance risk due to memory leaks?
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct

b) Is not correct

c) Is not correct

d) Is correct. The virtualized environment uses shared resources across different applications, including memory. The dynamic/cloud-based environment are designed to dynamically scale, so while memory leaks may occur, they are less of a risk because the environment will scale to compensate. Client/Server and browser-based environments are prone to memory leaks, particularly since a lot of this code is written in C and C++. Mobile environments are prone to leakage and are particularly at risk due to the limited available memory. The same is true of the embedded environments (and these also tend to be written in languages that have less protection against leaks). Mainframes tend to run older code, often written in the higher-level languages that provide their own memory management

questions.question: If performance testing is being conducted for software that is written in C++, what do you need to monitor that would not be a concern if the software were written in Python?

choices.A: Memory use
choices.B: Network latency
choices.C: Connectivity
choices.D: Batch processing

correctAnswerText: Memory use
questions.explanation:
a) Is correct. C and C++ require the programmer to do their own memory management which sometimes results in memory leaks (where memory is allocated, but not de-allocated)

b) Is not correct. Would have the same issues regardless of the language used

c) Is not correct. Would have the same issues regardless of the language used

d) Is not correct. Would have the same issues regardless of the language used

questions.question: You are working on a project that tracks health history information for patients across a region. The number of records handled by the system is in the millions due to the large number of patients in the region. Patient information must be accessible to doctors in offices, hospitals, and urgent care facilities. The information should be presented to the requestor within three seconds of request, particularly for patients with critical allergies and preconditions. Given this information, when is the best time in the project to analyze and assess the performance risks?

choices.A: During the requirements phase and again just prior to executing the performance tests
choices.B: After design but prior to coding
choices.C: During system testing and again prior to the performance tests
choices.D: Repeatedly throughout the requirements, development, and performance testing

correctAnswerText: Repeatedly throughout the requirements, development, and performance testing
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. Because it ignores looking at the risks during development

b) Is not correct. Because it leaves out the requirements and development and at the completion of development

c) Is not correct. Because it leaves out the requirements and development options for analysis

d) Is correct. Since performance is critical, the risks must be analyzed as early as possible and then repeatedly as the system is assembled since risks may change both in impact and likelihood

questions.question: You are working on a project that tracks health history information for patients across a region. The number of records handled by the system is in the millions due to the large number of patients in the region. Patient information must be accessible to doctors in offices, hospitals, and urgent care facilities. The information should be presented to the requestor within three seconds of request, particularly for patients with critical allergies and preconditions. What is the best way to address the performance testing for the response time?

choices.A: Test from the UI with the full data set loaded to ensure the response time will be adequate when the database is loaded
choices.B: Test via the web services at the API level to ensure access to the data is fast enough without having the testing complicated by the UI
choices.C: Conduct a technical review of the database implementation and conduct a performance test from the UI with the full database loaded
choices.D: Conduct a network assessment to ensure there are no latency issues between the database server and the web servers, then test with a network scanner to ensure no collisions are occurring that might cause performance delays

correctAnswerText: Conduct a technical review of the database implementation and conduct a performance test from the UI with the full database loaded
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. Because this leaves out the static testing

b) Is not correct. Because this would bypass any issues that might occur at the UI end and does not consider the database loading

c) Is correct. The best way to do the testing is to first do a technical analysis because this can be done at the design time. Once implemented, full testing will be needed to verify that the solution does indeed deliver the required performance

d) Is not correct. Because the network is less likely an issue regarding the data handling for such a large amount of data

questions.question: You are working on a project that tracks health history information for patients across a region. The number of records handled by the system is in the millions due to the large number of patients in the region. Patient information must be accessible to doctors in offices, hospitals, and urgent care facilities. The information should be presented to the requestor within three seconds of request, particularly for patients with critical allergies and preconditions. Which of the following is a technical objective for performance that could be applicable to this project?

choices.A: The response time must be within three seconds from the time the request is sent when there are 100 concurrent users making similar requests
choices.B: The system must be able to scale to 10 million patient records with no degradation in the performance
choices.C: The system must perform at or above the level of the legacy system when handling a similar load and responding to a similar request
choices.D: The response time must remain the same when the disaster recovery system is in use rather than the primary system and the switchover must cause no discernable downtime

correctAnswerText: The system must be able to scale to 10 million patient records with no degradation in the performance
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. Because this is a user-based objective

b) Is correct. Scalability is a technical objective for performance

c) Is not correct. Because this is also a user-based objective and not a very clear one at that

d) Is not correct. Because this is primarily a robustness test rather than a performance test

questions.question: You are working on a project that tracks health history information for patients across a region. The number of records handled by the system is in the millions due to the large number of patients in the region. Patient information must be accessible to doctors in offices, hospitals, and urgent care facilities. The information should be presented to the requestor within three seconds of request, particularly for patients with critical allergies and preconditions. You have been asked to write a performance test plan for this project. Which of the following is the information you will need to deal with the most critical performance objective?

choices.A: Who can access what data and how often will they do it
choices.B: How is user access authenticated and authorized
choices.C: Where will the data be stored and how much storage is available
choices.D: What is the expected use of the data after it has been presented to the user

correctAnswerText: Who can access what data and how often will they do it
questions.explanation:
a) Is correct. Because data retrieval time is critical to the project, you need to know who can access that data (so you can get the user profiles created), what data they will access (so you can be sure you have the right data available) and how often will they access it (so you can set up an operational profile)

b) Is not correct. Because this is more related to security than performance testing and is not the most critical performance objective

c) Is not correct. Because the data storage may be something to investigate if the data retrieval proves slow, but we do not need to know it to conduct the tests

d) Is not correct. Because that is after retrieval and the scenario just discusses presenting the information to the requestor

questions.question: What is the value of nesting transactions for performance testing?

choices.A: It supports the concept of parent and child transactions
choices.B: It allows the tester to measure a series of discrete transactions
choices.C: It speeds the reporting time for the performance results
choices.D: It bypasses the network communication time by sending the transaction directly to the server that will process it

correctAnswerText: It allows the tester to measure a series of discrete transactions
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. Because parent and child transactions may not accomplish anything meaningful in terms of system usage

b) Is correct. The discrete transactions can be nested together to provide response information for a series of transactions that would normally be performed together while still allowing measurement of the discrete transactions as well

c) Is not correct. Because it will not affect the reporting time, particularly if the discrete transactions are tracked as well. It may increase reporting time

d) Is not correct. Because this has nothing to do with bypassing network communications

choices.B: The number of users across the system for this role is not known

d) Is not correct. Considerations for setting up the load profile but not needed for the operational profile

questions.question: What is one of the advantages to conducting performance tests at the protocol level?

choices.A: It is the easiest method for manual scripting
choices.B: It is the best way to evaluate the total user experience

choices.D: It is the best way to handle data correlation

correctAnswerText: It is scalable because the client is bypassed

questions.question: What is the best method to use for verifying that a performance test script added users to a system?

choices.C: Use the script to verify through the application that the users were created
choices.D: Use the script to verify that the users exist in the database

correctAnswerText: Use the script to verify that the users exist in the database
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. Because no errors do not mean that it worked - it could just mean that the error handling is also broken

b) Is not correct. Because this could be a very time-consuming approach

c) Is not correct. Because the application may have a defect that causes it to not find the new users

d) Is correct. Scripts should contain their own checks that the process has worked and verifying via the database directly is a more efficient way to do it (and more maintainable) than having the script do the verification through the application (which may also be wrong) as this adds to the maintenance requirements of the script

questions.question: You are working on a project that tracks health history information for patients across a region. The number of records handled by the system is in the millions due to the large number of patients in the region. Patient information must be accessible to doctors in offices, hospitals, and urgent care facilities. The information should be presented to the requestor within three seconds of request, particularly for patients with critical allergies and preconditions. One of the operational profiles you have identified is an emergency room doctor. You have determined that this person will access the system 10 times per shift (a shift is 10 hours) and that they will normally view 6 patient records for each access. They will print those patient records to be retained in the patient file at the hospital. They will also enter notes into the database regarding the patient's treatment. For new patients, another user will enter the information into the system. You have created a performance script that logs in as a doctor (from a list of doctors) and then performs the patient look ups. When you run the script, the login works, but then you are not able to perform the patient look ups. You are getting an error that indicates the user is not known to the system. What is likely your problem?

choices.A: The script is not capturing and re-using the system identifier for the user
choices.B: You cannot use the same user to log in and do the patient look ups because the user has expired
choices.C: The script needs to pass the login username/password for each transaction
choices.D: The login information from the previous user is cached by the system and you need to clear the cache before you can log in as a new user

correctAnswerText: The script is not capturing and re-using the system identifier for the user
questions.explanation:
a) Is correct. The problem is most likely with the system identifier that is given to that particular user when they login. When they try to do another transaction, that unique identifier needs to be passed to the system so it can provide access to the transaction

b) Is not correct. Because there is no indication that this is the problem

c) Is not correct. Because the question indicates that the doctor performs multiple lookups per access

d) Is not correct. Because if this were happening, it would log in as the previous user, not error out on the login

questions.question: You are testing a sales application for an e-commerce system. You are particularly interested in the response time for when a user enters text to be used to search for an item in the database. You have noticed that the first time you ran the tests it took 5.00 seconds to respond, but subsequent queries with the same data are responding in 0.01 seconds. What should you have done during your scripting to prevent this issue?

choices.A: There is no issue, the system is just getting faster
choices.B: You need to log in each time to ensure that the transaction is performed again
choices.C: You need to be sure the cache is cleared because the query results are probably being cached
choices.D: You need to use a different user for each test to avoid the user's information being re-used without being restored

correctAnswerText: You need to be sure the cache is cleared because the query results are probably being cached
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. Is highly unlikely as systems tend to get slower, not faster, unless there is a caching issue

b) Is not correct. Because it is not the user's information that is being re- used but rather the search results

c) Is correct. This is a symptom of caching and can be avoided by either varying the data or by clearing the cache

d) Is not correct. Because it is not the user's information that is being re- used but rather the search results

questions.question: What happens when the performance test system is not equivalent to the production environment?

choices.A: Projections become less reliable, and risk increases because the results may not be representative
choices.B: The tests will tend to run more quickly because they are not burdened by production data
choices.C: The results will be easier to understand because the system can be configured for a particular test
choices.D: Projects become more reliable because of the targeted focus, and this results in risk being reduced

correctAnswerText: Projections become less reliable, and risk increases because the results may not be representative
questions.explanation:
a) Is correct. The less like production the performance testing system is, the less reliable are the results and this increases the risk of making incorrect assumptions

b) Is not correct. It could happen, but not necessarily

c) Is not correct. Because there is no reason to think the results would be easier to understand with a different configuration

d) Is not correct. Because the project risk would actually be increased in this case

questions.question: What is a concern when using a properly configured load generation tool to build the background load for the performance tests?

choices.A: The load generated will contain invalid data
choices.B: The load generator may experience performance problems and will not be able to maintain a steady load
choices.C: The load generated may affect the production system and the production data
choices.D: The load generator log reports may be difficult to read, resulting in problems with interpreting the performance results

correctAnswerText: The load generator may experience performance problems and will not be able to maintain a steady load
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. Will not occur if the tool is configured properly

b) Is correct. A load generator, particularly if you are running multiples on one machine, may slow down enough that it is no longer maintaining the desired load on the system

c) Is not correct. Will not occur if the tool is configured properly

d) Is not correct. Is not an issue as the load generator is not usually used to generate the performance results - it just creates the load on the system so the performance tests can be conducted

questions.question: What is the purpose of having a ramp up period at the beginning of performance tests?

choices.A: To increase the number of users beyond the desired load
choices.B: To allow the system to achieve a steady state before taking measurements
choices.C: To allow the system to achieve an orderly shut down after the tests
choices.D: To ensure the performance monitoring tools are working

correctAnswerText: To allow the system to achieve a steady state before taking measurements
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. Because the goal of the ramp up to is to get the number of users to the point desired for the test, not to exceed that number

b) Is correct. The system must have started up and achieved a steady state for valid steady state performance metrics to be gathered

c) Is not correct. Because ramp up is increasing load, not decreasing it getting ready for shut down

d) Is not correct. Because this has nothing to do with ramp up and should be tested before any official tests are started

questions.question: What is a method for testing transient states?

choices.A: Steady load testing
choices.B: Peak and valley testing
choices.C: Spike testing
choices.D: Scalability testing

correctAnswerText: Spike testing
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct

b) Is not correct

c) Is correct. This is achieved with spike tests which force the system to transition between a low load to a high load in a short period of time

d) Is not correct

questions.question:
You are working on a project that tracks health history information for patients across a region. The number of records handled by the system is in the millions due to the large number of patients in the region. Patient information must be accessible to doctors in offices, hospitals, and urgent care facilities. The information should be presented to the requestor within three seconds of request, particularly for patients with critical allergies and preconditions. You have conducted your tests and have determined the following metrics:
< 3 second response time: 85% of the time
< 5 second response time: 90% of the time
<10 second response time: 95% of the time
< 60 second response time: 100% of the time
Given this information, how should you present the results to the stakeholders?

choices.A: The test failed; the system is too slow. The requirements should be reviewed to ensure that <3 seconds is required 100% of the time
choices.B: 85% of the time the performance goal is met, so the system should be accepted based on industry standards
choices.C: The response time for 90% of the tests is probably acceptable, but more tuning is needed to bring down the 95% response time
choices.D: The response time for 100% of the tests is unacceptable and tuning will be required to bring it down to <3 seconds

correctAnswerText: The response time for 90% of the tests is probably acceptable, but more tuning is needed to bring down the 95% response time
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct. This is also a problem with the requirements being unclear. Does it have to be less than 3 seconds 100% of the time? Or is it acceptable if it is 95%? As stated though, the system has failed the test and the requirements should be revisited.

b) Is not correct. Because the goal did not stay 85% of the time was acceptable

c) Is correct. Might be a good result if the requirements had been better defined. Right now, they say that 100% must be less than 3 seconds. Realistically though, the 90% time should be investigated to see if there are a few outliers that are bringing it down or if it is always at the 5 second mark. More tuning should be attempted though because this is a critical system and performance could be life or death impacting

d) Is not correct. Because tuning to get to below 3 seconds 100% of the time will probably not be possible

questions.question: What is the purpose of a load generator tool?

choices.A: It creates a load on the network to allow testing for collisions
choices.B: It maintains a load on the user interface to accurately mimic user response time
choices.C: It feeds data to the dashboard showing how the system is responding to the load
choices.D: It simulates user behavior according to the operational profiles

questions.explanation:

b) Is not correct. Might be a browser testing tool or might not exist

c) Is not correct. Is a monitoring too

d) Is correct. This is what a load generator tool does

questions.question: What is a pay-as-you-go tool?

choices.B: A server-based tool that provides you with full ownership of the tool for your usage
choices.C: A monitoring tool that populates the dashboard with pertinent metrics based on what you have paid to monitor
choices.D: A tool that provides the ability to test from multiple points of presence for load generation

b) Is not correct. As these are not descriptions of pay-as-you-go tools

c) Is not correct. As these are not descriptions of pay-as-you-go tools

questions.question: You are working on a project that tracks health history information for patients across a region. Patient information must be accessible to doctors in offices, hospitals, and urgent care facilities. The information should be presented to the requestor within three seconds of request, particularly for patients with critical allergies and preconditions. You have a technical team conducting the performance tests and they are comfortable with programming the performance test scripts for re-usability and maintainability. You are now looking for a tool to use for this testing. You have found one that is compatible with your environment and will be able to generate a load via the protocols in use. The team has looked at it and they are comfortable that they can code in the tool and will be able to create their scripts with little training. Because there are many stakeholders for this testing, you have verified that the tool provides excellent monitoring and reporting capabilities. You have verified with the various system administrators that they are comfortable with the tool and happy to use its monitoring capabilities in addition to their own tools during the testing. What do you still need to verify before selecting this tool?

choices.A: The project schedules
choices.B: The availability of a record/playback capability for your testers to use
choices.C: The ability of the tool to meet your requirements for concurrent virtual users
choices.D: The ease with which your team can code the required performance scripts

correctAnswerText: The ability of the tool to meet your requirements for concurrent virtual users
questions.explanation:
a) Is not correct

b) Is not correct

c) Is correct. At this point you know that your testers are able to code what is needed. The project schedule is not really a factor because any tool will take time to acquire and integrate, but the developers can code in it, so that is the main schedule factor. What you need to know is can this tool simulate the necessary number of virtual users and, of course, how much will it cost
